name: sim_pyg_hopf_graph_deep_capability
operation_sequence: project each quaternion to S2 with the Hopf map
build a sparse undirected edge_index from pairwise Hopf-image distance below a fixed threshold
run two GCNConv MessagePassing layers over the node features and edge_index
threshold output-vector norms to form an admitted node set
compare admitted sets and output tensors against no-edge, fully-connected, zero-weight, random-graph, near-zero-threshold, and near-full-threshold controls
carrier_topology: Finite 32-node graph fixture whose nodes are sampled on S3 and whose edges are induced by great-circle distance between Hopf-map images on S2; this is a classical graph fixture, not a GStack, bridge, axis, QIT, or nonclassical carrier admission.

observable.primary: admitted node set after thresholding GCNConv output norms
secondary: Frobenius relative change between Hopf-edge and no-edge GCN outputs
Frobenius relative difference between sparse Hopf-edge and fully-connected GCN outputs
exact admitted-set agreement count for same-density random graph controls
near-zero threshold edge count and no-edge relative change
near-full threshold edge count and full-graph relative difference

pass_fail_predicate: Pass iff all positive tests pass, all negative controls fail to reproduce the claimed message-passing effect, and both boundary thresholds collapse to their expected no-edge or fully-connected baselines.
graveyards: zero-weight GCNConv control should remove edge-dependent output deltas
same-density Erdos-Renyi graph controls should not reproduce the exact Hopf-edge admitted partition across trials
near-zero edge threshold should collapse to the no-edge graph baseline
near-full edge threshold should collapse to the complete graph baseline
no-edge graph should change the admitted node set relative to the Hopf-edge graph if PyG message passing is load-bearing
baselines: near-zero and near-full threshold boundary baselines
alternative_formulations: replace GCNConv with a different PyG MessagePassing operator while preserving the same edge_index controls
construct the edge_index from Euclidean S3 chord distance instead of Hopf-image S2 distance
replace random node features with deterministic Hopf-coordinate features
tool_function_needs: torch.Tensor indexing and torch.linalg.norm for output-delta observables
lego_coupling_target: bounded PyG graph-message-passing capability evidence for later graph-structured lego-fit probes
claim_ceiling: finite sim_pyg_hopf_graph_deep_capability classical-baseline receipt only; no bridge, GStack, axis, QIT, or nonclassical admission

pytorch.reason: Tensor substrate for node features, edge indices, and GCN weight matrices; torch.linalg.norm used to compute Frobenius deltas between output tensors

pyg.reason: GCNConv MessagePassing computes neighbourhood-aggregated node embeddings on the Hopf-fiber graph; the admitted node set is defined by thresholding GCN output norms, making PyG load-bearing for the admissibility claim

z3.reason: numeric graph structure probe does not require SMT proof layer

cvc5.reason: not needed; admissibility criterion is empirical, not symbolic

sympy.reason: Hopf fiber distance formula is closed-form; no symbolic algebra needed

clifford.reason: quaternion operations implemented directly in torch; clifford not needed

geomstats.reason: S3 sampling done analytically; geomstats not required here

e3nn.reason: SO(3) equivariance not the focus of this Hopf-graph structure probe

rustworkx.reason: graph representation handled entirely by PyG edge_index tensors

xgi.reason: hypergraph structure not needed; pairwise edges only

toponetx.reason: cell-complex topology not needed; this probe targets graph-level structure

gudhi.reason: persistent homology not required for this graph-structure test

pos_a_structure_changes_admissibility.note: GCN message passing over Hopf-fiber edges must change the admitted node set

pos_c_sparse_vs_full_distinct.note: Hopf-sparse and fully-connected graphs must yield different admitted node sets

neg_a_identity_gcn_no_delta.note: Zero-weight GCN should not show >10% delta — confirms delta is due to message passing

neg_b_random_graph_differs.note: Random graphs at same density must not reproduce exact Hopf admissibility partition

boundary_a_near_zero_threshold.note: Near-zero threshold yields disconnected graph; GCN degenerates to no-edge baseline

boundary_b_near_full_threshold.note: Large threshold approaches fully-connected; GCN output should converge to full-graph output

divergence_log: Classical-baseline divergence controls: Hopf-fiber graph message passing is compared against identity-weight/no-information-flow, same-density random graph, near-zero threshold no-edge behavior, and near-full threshold saturation; failures demote this baseline receipt.
surviving_alternatives: This receipt covers only bounded PyG Hopf-graph message-passing behavior as a classical baseline; it does not promote graph-shell geometry, Werner structure, bridge, axis, GStack, or nonclassical admission.
demotion_condition: Demote this PyG Hopf-graph baseline receipt if Hopf-edge message-passing deltas, edge removal controls, random-graph controls, near-zero threshold behavior, or near-full threshold behavior fail on rerun.
next_lego_target: Use as bounded PyG Hopf-graph classical-baseline capability evidence before exact graph lego-fit or coupling packets.
promotion_condition: Requires separate coupling/coexistence receipts and explicit stage-gate approval.
blocked_until: explicit coupling-stage admission and companion receipts
